text_block_list.text: Grrr...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we walk back to the academy, I hear
a feeble
and vaguely cute-sounding
noise.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You fool! I'm appalled that you'd even
suggest as
much. You need to get your
ears checked!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That was clearly an animal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look around and find...

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Whine... Whine...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's a puppy...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And it's injured. It looks like it's been
pecked at...
The crows around here can
be quite vicious.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No collar. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hold on. Your heart is in the right place,
but
poorly administered medical care
can do more
harm than good.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let's consult a professional first. I
believe there's
a place nearby that
specializes in taking care of
stray
animals.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hello? My name is Air Groove, and I'm a
student
at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I found an injured puppy by the river
near the
academy. It doesn't have a
collar.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, someone from the animal
protection
group comes and takes care
of the puppy.

text_block_list.name: Veterinary Staff
text_block_list.text:
All done. The injuries weren't too bad.
They
should heal before too long.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's a relief. Thank you for coming so
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Veterinary Staff
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you so much for calling us.
Hey, little
fella. You should say thanks
too!

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof woof! Yip!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! Calm down! You haven't fully

recovered yet!

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof woof!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Hahaha! You're quite
rambunctious, aren't
you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? If you have something to say, just
say it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're a terrible liar, you know. Go
on—spit it
out!

text_block_list.name: Veterinary Staff
text_block_list.text: E-excuse me? Sorry to butt in, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Not at all! What is it?

text_block_list.name: Veterinary Staff
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to ask what you wish to do with
this little
one.

text_block_list.name: Veterinary Staff
text_block_list.text:
So you see, I'm afraid we're full up with
other
strays at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Veterinary Staff
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind watching her until we
can find a
good home?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Y-you want me to take care of it?

text_block_list.name: Veterinary Staff
text_block_list.text:
I understand it's a big ask, but she seems
to have
taken quite the shine to you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Unfortunately, the academy has
a strict
no-pet policy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've also never owned a dog before... I'm
not sure
I would be capable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's objections make sense, but
after
seeing how she smiled moments
ago, I have a
hard time believing she
means them. I decide to
chime in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's objections make sense, but
after
seeing how she smiled moments
ago, I have a
hard time believing she
means them. I decide to
chime in.
choice_data_list: Then maybe I should hold onto it in my room~
Then maybe I'll look after it in my room~

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What?! Have you given proper
consideration to
the meaning of what
you're saying?!
choice_data_list: Then maybe I should hold onto it in my room~
Then maybe I'll look after it in my room~

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Taking care of an animal isn't all fun and
games,
you know!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Dogs, especially, require a ridiculous
amount of
care and attention. You have
to walk them, train
them, brush their
fur...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And you wish to hog all of that for
yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Ack.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Graaahhhh, enough!
choice_data_list: Dogs really are cute, aren't they?
Dogs are just so cute, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't be able to get a wink of sleep
knowing
that she's in the hands of
someone as
irresponsible as you! I'll get
the permission to care
for her myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And as if to respond to Air Groove's cry,
the
puppy yaps happily at her feet.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You really think so?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... This is a life-or-death matter! We
have to
take it seriously.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And what makes you so confident?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Air Groove that after all the time
I've spent
with her, I know she can do
anything she sets her
mind to.
choice_data_list: The fact that I'm your Trainer!
The fact that I'm your Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Frankly, your endless optimism grates on
my
nerves. But I shall live up to your
estimation of
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Come on, little one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And as if to respond to Air Groove's cry,
the
puppy yaps happily at her feet.
